decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed rear roof extension, by reason of its scale, siting and box-like design, forms a dominant, unsympathetic and visually intrusive addition to the original building. It would fail to read as a subordinate roof addition and would not integrate successfully with its surroundings. The proposed development is therefore contrary to Policies LP1 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 2 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE: Please be advised that the application has been assessed on the basis of the submitted drawings under reference numbers 205-003, 205-004, 205-005 and 205/006. Officers note that these drawings do not accurately reflect the form of development evident on site, including indications of a vertical increase in ridge height. In the absence of alternative accurate and reliable drawings, the Local Planning Authority has been obliged to determine the application on the basis of the information submitted.
